tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: EStyleColor::Black. Dividers and shadow strokes, for example the notification border. Not a page ground.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Window and tab-well ground behind panels; the major-tab content area. Text on it is foreground (10.04:1).

tokens.name: title
tokens.usage: Tab well fill under window chrome (SDockingTabStack.cpp:1234) and the project badge tint. Text on it is foreground (10.04:1).

tokens.name: window-border
tokens.usage: 2px outer border stroke of a window.

tokens.name: foldout
tokens.usage: Ground of progress bar tracks (StarshipCoreStyle.cpp:547).

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Ground of text boxes, spin boxes, search boxes and slider tracks. Text on it is foreground (10.54:1) or foreground-hover.

tokens.name: input-outline
tokens.usage: 1px resting outline of an input. Contrast against panel is 1.32:1, below the 3:1 floor for a control border; this is the source value.

tokens.name: recessed
tokens.usage: Wells set below a panel: window background, separators, log text boxes. Text on it is foreground.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Standard panel ground: dock tab content, details body, tooltips' neighbours, expandable areas. Text on it is foreground (8.53:1).

tokens.name: header
tokens.usage: Table headers, category headers, unchecked filter buttons. Text on it is foreground-header (8.00:1).

tokens.name: dropdown
tokens.usage: Ground of dropdown buttons and tooltips. Text on it is foreground (6.44:1) or foreground-hover (11.73:1).

tokens.name: dropdown-outline
tokens.usage: 1px outline of dropdowns and tooltips. Contrast against panel is 1.81:1, below the 3:1 floor for a control border; this is the source value.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Hovered button ground, resting scrollbar thumb and hover input outline. Pair it with foreground-hover (7.23:1); foreground on it is only 3.97:1.

tokens.name: hover-2
tokens.usage: Hovered or dragged scrollbar thumb. Never a text ground.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Pure white: app logo and text on a primary fill.

tokens.name: white-25
tokens.usage: 25 percent white overlay for subtle lifts over any ground.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Text selection background and highlight fills. Same value as primary.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, active tab accents, checked toggles, focus ring. White text on it is 4.78:1.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hovered primary fill. White text on it is 3.58:1, below 4.5:1 for small text; this is the source value.

tokens.name: primary-press
tokens.usage: Pressed primary fill. White text on it is 7.91:1.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary button fill, splitter highlight, filter chip ground. Text on it is foreground (6.44:1).

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Default text and icon colour on panel, background, header, input, dropdown and recessed grounds.

tokens.name: foreground-hover
tokens.usage: Text and icon colour while hovered, pressed or selected. Use on hover, primary and select-inactive grounds.

tokens.name: foreground-inverted
tokens.usage: Dark text on a light fill. Alias of input; 10.54:1 on foreground.

tokens.name: foreground-header
tokens.usage: Text on a header ground (8.00:1).

tokens.name: select
tokens.usage: Selected row ground in the focused view. White text on it is 4.78:1.

tokens.name: select-inactive
tokens.usage: Selected row ground when the view has no focus. Use foreground-hover on it (7.47:1); foreground is only 4.11:1.

tokens.name: select-parent
tokens.usage: Tint on a collapsed row that contains the selection. Text on it is foreground (7.11:1).

tokens.name: select-hover
tokens.usage: Hovered row ground in a tree or list. Same value as panel.

tokens.name: notifications
tokens.usage: Toast notification ground. Text on it is foreground-hover (8.81:1).
